parsed.post: The latest attempt (1.049) regressed from the best (1.032). The slight increase in LR or shift in hyperparameters likely destabilized convergence. Reverting to e85d513. I will now try increasing DEPTH to 6 again, but with a much more conservative learning rate and higher weight decay to handle the capacity increase.
parsed.description: Increasing capacity to DEPTH=6 while significantly lowering learning rate and increasing weight decay to stabilize the higher-order features.
